summary: Verified the visual-edits/babel-metadata-plugin.js fix. Webpack now compiles cleanly with 1 ESLint warning (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps) and 0 errors — previous 'ERROR in ./src/components/ui/carousel.jsx' and 'signature-pad.jsx' from `null.traverse(...)` are gone. Line 936-940 confirmed uses `const programPath = importPath.parentPath; if (!programPath || typeof programPath.traverse !== 'function') return; programPath.traverse({...})`. Backend login + 6 admin endpoints all 200. Public payment page /facture/payer/{token} renders correctly with Stripe/Interac/Wise. All admin dashboard routes load without compile-error banner. Home page carousel renders (embla-based).

issues: React hydration warnings: visual-edits plugin wraps <tr> in a <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <tbody>, which is invalid HTML. Pre-existing issue in the visual-edits instrumentation, unrelated to the current fix but noisy in console.

action_items: Optional: Address hydration warning caused by visual-edits plugin injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> around dynamic <tr> children in <tbody>. Not blocking, but pollutes console.
critical_code_review_comments: babel-metadata-plugin.js fix is defensive and correct — guards against non-traverseable parent paths. Consider applying same guard pattern to other similar `parentPath.parentPath.traverse` calls in the file to prevent recurrence.
